primary_operating_point.rule: Annual pooled Top10% capacity; no outcome-based threshold optimization
primary_operating_point.tie_policy: capacity_weights expected fractional allocation at boundary-score ties

separate_fixed_probability_operating_poi.rule: p >= 0.5; supplied as a distinct diagnostic, not used for case or subgroup selection

case_selection.method: Highest-probability FP and TP; lowest-probability FN; stable order; no fractional membership cases
case_selection.public_identifiers: Anonymous case_id only; no inspection IDs, entity IDs, names, addresses or licenses exported
case_selection.caveat: Extreme illustrative cases are selected after observing test outcomes; they do not represent group frequencies

profile_definitions.counts_and_shares: Weighted by expected global priority allocation when ties occur
profile_definitions.prior_counts: Entity inspection days, not raw event rows
profile_definitions.recent_pass: Last observed result is Pass and days since last inspection <=365
profile_definitions.missing_means: Numeric means use observed values only; corresponding missing fractions are reported
profile_definitions.small_subgroups: n<100 or fewer than 10 Fail or 10 Non-Fail cases; no comparative ranking claims

descriptive_patterns.pattern: Missed failures and previously observed Pass results
Priority false positives retain historical failure evidence
History coverage and misses despite observed history

limitations: SHAP explains the fitted score, not the real-world cause of an inspection result.
Current outcomes are read only to describe errors and conditional Pass, never as predictive inputs.
Associations cannot distinguish changed practices, incomplete history, inspector effects or unobserved hazards.
Capacity misses are not interchangeable with probability-threshold errors or newly proven safety risks.
